A '''steel hoe''' is the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[Tools#Hoe|hoe]], made by smithing an [[iron hoe]] with [[steel alloy]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template. Enchantments on the iron item carry over; where both items have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Farming and mining ===
It breaks hoe blocks at speed 8, the same as the iron hoe, but lasts 3000 uses. Hoes in Matcha Flavoured also break wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|1}} damage at an attack speed of 2, slower than the iron hoe. Steel tools reuse the removed stone tools' item IDs, so where the item sets no attack attributes of its own it keeps the stone tool's values.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack speed 3 (real value 2).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_hoe.json}}</ref>
